class.name: MoveSystem
class.brief_description:
Demo C++ system that integrates Position and Velocity components.
演示用 C++ 系统：对 Position 与 Velocity 组件做积分。
class.description:
An example system compiled into the extension. For every entity with both [code]Position[/code] and [code]Velocity[/code], it adds [code]velocity * delta[/code] to position. Demonstrates the typed [code]World::for_each<Position, Velocity>[/code] hot path with zero Variant overhead.
一个编译进扩展的示例系统。对每个同时拥有 [code]Position[/code] 与 [code]Velocity[/code] 的实体，它把 [code]velocity * delta[/code] 累加到 position。演示了零 Variant 开销的类型化 [code]World::for_each<Position, Velocity>[/code] 热路径。

method.name: get_processed_count
method.description:
Returns how many entities the system processed on its last tick (used by tests and the demo).
返回系统在最近一次驱动中处理的实体数量（供测试与 demo 使用）。
